must_fix.title: Command reference page does not list the new top-level `worker` command
must_fix.detail: tests/test_docs_product_reference.py::test_reference_lists_every_top_level_command asserts that every live top-level CLI command appears as `name` (backticked) in docs/product/reference/index.md. The new `nw worker` group is missing, so the test fails with "reference missing top-level command 'worker'". The failure was reproduced on a targeted rerun. Add a row to the command table in docs/product/reference/index.md, in the same format as the existing rows (e.g. line 35: | `queue` | Agentic work queue: ... | [Agentic loop](../capabilities/agentic.md) |). Keep the table's alphabetical/ordering convention. Suggested row: | `worker` | Remote gate worker: gate-job / have / gc / info / ssh-command (runs on the worker host) | [Workflow](../../WORKFLOW.md) | — adjust the relative link so it resolves, or reuse the agentic capability page. Optionally also check whether the capabilities page docs/product/capabilities/agentic.md should mention it.
